comparison.against_also: promotion-7 counts (9736 / 9052 / 627 / 26 / 31); that promotion left no red-name list, so it can be compared by counts only
comparison.arithmetic: the case set grew by 3 (4 added, 1 removed; all four added were green), so pass 9051 -> 9044 and fail 627 -> 634 among the 9735 existing cases: exactly 7 existing cases went green -> red, and 0 went red -> green

timeouts_rerun.why: a timeout on the first occurrence is not red: the host was at 1m load 28.19 and the gate itself printed that its readings were not comparable to a quiet host
timeouts_rerun.note: run at the original timeout, not doubled: passing at 1x is a stronger statement than passing at 2x
timeouts_rerun.note_on_those_two: both were red in promotion-4's list as well, so they are inherited reds and not this round's; the whole-layer run shows them as timeouts, and a timeout covers the real reason -- only running them alone showed it

later_reading_not_the_basis.why_not_the_basis: D-1126-30: develop is pushed to the commit the whole layer measured for this promotion; this later reading is evidence for the next one

ruling: D-1126-30: a develop push is checked against the promotion record of the pushed tip, not against one pass record per merge; the tip's whole-layer reading already covers every merge in range
